summary: Mesa Verde NP lookout on Whites Mesa: Aermotor tower moved from Apache NF in 1963, steel cab added 1964; NHLR-registered 2010; 2019 review found it in good condition.

facts.design: Aermotor tower, lower 30 feet used, with 14 by 14 foot platform and 7 by 7 foot steel cab added in 1964

events.note: Aermotor tower moved from the Apache National Forest and erected; the register's Built field gives 1963

Condition review: tower in good condition; wooden platforms could use replacement; cab interior needs painting

notes_for_editor: Height is not set: the Register gives only the lower 30 feet used, not the overall height. No staffing, access, visit or fire history appears in any source read, so those keys are omitted. The Register does not say who moved the tower from the Apache National Forest. Status standing rests on the 2019 condition review. The cooperator evidence quote now includes the name Mesa Verde National Park, as printed on the Register page. Fact-check 2026-10-08: the story no longer says the wooden platforms are 'due for replacement'; the Register says they 'could use replacement'.
